name: web-scaire-ai-assistant-hero-glowing-diamond-icon-on-black
title: Scaire AI assistant hero: a glowing green diamond icon over 'Your personal AI for real life assistant'
whatItIs: A black landing hero with a top nav (Product, Use cases, Docs, Customers, Pricing), a glowing green faceted diamond icon radiating light rays and forming a V-shape, a headline 'Your personal AI for real life assistant' with 'personal' in green, 'Get started' and 'Request demo' buttons, and a row of partner logos (justo, amazon, Adobe, Webflow, shopify).
whatItMeans: Futuristic and premium; the glowing gem icon gives an abstract AI assistant a striking, ownable symbol.
techniques: Use a glowing 3D icon with radiating light rays as the hero.
Let the icon's light form a V leading to the headline.
Colour only the emotionally key word in the headline.

vocabulary.definition: Light lines emanating outward from a glowing object.
A central graphic symbol representing the product.
